behaviors.source: GH #80 What to build; PRD story 1
behaviors.given: an initial, repair, or resumed generator finds that a cited finding's correct fix needs an undeclared path
behaviors.when: the generator stops before making the out-of-scope edit
behaviors.then: it writes version-1 escalation.md with non-empty findingIds, paths, and reason
behaviors.observableResult: the canonical escalation artifact contains the cited findings, required paths, and explanation before any out-of-scope edit

behaviors.source: GH #80 AC2 and AC4; PRD story 13; ADR 0048
behaviors.given: escalation.md is malformed or requests an ineligible scope path
behaviors.then: the slice ends ERROR without planner or gate execution and retains the raw artifact
behaviors.observableResult: the ERROR outcome and archived raw attempt expose every refused escalation without downstream execution

behaviors.source: GH #80 AC1 and AC5; PRD Implementation Decisions
behaviors.given: a valid escalation names findings, undeclared non-migration paths, and a reason
behaviors.then: the orchestrator archives the attempt and sends the exact evidence through one focused planner revision and fresh contract evaluation without spending an implementation round
behaviors.observableResult: captured planner input contains the submitted findingIds, paths, and reason exactly, with an attempt archive and unchanged generator round count

behaviors.given: the revised contract and manifest declare the requested scope and the evaluator accepts them
behaviors.then: a fresh generator runs with the evaluator-accepted complete revised fileScope and the same remaining implementation-round budget
behaviors.observableResult: captured fresh-generator input contains the accepted locked manifest's revised fileScope before generation resumes

behaviors.source: GH #80 AC2 and AC5; ADR 0048 archive convention
behaviors.given: generator invocations produce valid or malformed escalations
behaviors.then: each raw file receives a round-and-attempt-stamped archive and an existing archive is never overwritten
behaviors.observableResult: all escalation-r<round>-a<attempt>.md files remain under the slice reviews archive

behaviors.then: migration checks, base gates, QA, retries, and existing terminal outcomes proceed unchanged
behaviors.observableResult: normal generator execution retains the existing PASS, STUCK, ERROR, and CANCELLED paths

behaviors.source: GH #80 revision-template requirement; PRD dependency on PRD 1
behaviors.given: ordinary contract negotiation or revision runs
behaviors.when: planner and evaluator artifacts are processed
behaviors.then: exact validation, the two-round cap, orchestrator-owned lock transitions, and attempt archives remain intact
behaviors.observableResult: existing negotiation scenarios retain their validation, round, lock, and archive results

behaviors.given: QA requests SCOPE_AMENDMENT for already-written correct work
behaviors.then: planScopeAmendment and applyScopeAmendment retain amendment records and same-round re-grading
behaviors.observableResult: the existing QA-side amendment route behaves as specified by ADR 0048
